children: UBS reiterated a Buy rating and $340 price target on Cheniere Energy
, pointing to a record of delivering projects on time and on budget. Shares were down 1.43% intraday.

The company told investors on its second quarter call that roughly a third of the increase in its revised 2026 volume guidance of 53 to 54 million tonnes per annum came from the Stage 3 ramp, with trains starting earlier than planned. UBS said that revision only modestly reflected the benefit, and that management could lift guidance again before year-end.

UBS described global LNG as undersupplied, citing extended downtime at a major Qatari facility and a widening spread between European TTF and US Henry Hub prices. The firm said Cheniere's ability to accelerate project start-ups represents a competitive advantage.

title: UBS Sees Cheniere Raising Volume Guidance Again This Year
